name: rati-swarm
description: Local source workspace for built-in, RATi, and user-configured scanners.
author: RATi

scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
